messages:
alyssa: FYI ran the nightly reconciler and saw ~1.2k tokens that didn't map to any billing event. small spike but persistent over last 3 runs. any ideas?
jorge: do you have the sample keys? could be a fingerprint mismatch from the compact path.
alyssa: pasted a quick query: 
```sql
SELECT token_id, src, ts FROM token_events
WHERE ts >= '2026-03-20' AND status = 'unattributed'
LIMIT 50;
```
meera: hmm if they're 'unattributed' could be late-arrival ordering with the new shard split. we updated shard routing last week.
sam: Agree w/ meera. We did change the routing for low-traffic tenants which could push some events to the slow path and miss the canonicalizer window.
alyssa: @sam @meera ok. two quick asks: 1) can we add a lightweight audit marker when events hit the slow path (so reconciler can correlate), 2) do we accept small multi-hour lag or do a targeted backfill?
jorge: proposal: emit audit_event {token_id, route_bucket, arrival_ts, canonicalized=false} at ingress for slow-path. reconciler then picks up those markers and cross-checks final billing events. low overhead (single small msg).
meera: tradeoff: more ingress events means more storage in the short term but avoids expensive full-table backfills. we can sample at first (1%) and raise if we see correlation.
sam: also consider adding a compact-path handshake field so the canonicalizer can ack an ingestion id. that way reconciler can join on id instead of fuzzy token matching.
alyssa: good. can we ship a sampling plan first week and an always-on audit after we validate? want to avoid extra noise on SRE alarms.
reconciler-bot: reconciler-run-1762129999 finished: unmatched_count=1234, sample_unmatched=50, run_time=00:06:12
jorge: let's do sample 0.5% for two days then 1% for a week if stable. add a metric: unmatched_rate_by_route.
meera: implementable checklist: 1) ingress: emit audit marker on slow-path (feature flag), 2) canonicalizer: attach ingestion_id when finalizing, 3) reconciler: correlate audit markers and ingestion_id joins, 4) alert: unmatched_rate > 0.1% -> run backfill runbook.
sam: runbook note: for tenants with >100k tokens/day we should prefer backfill windowed by ingestion_id to avoid broad reprocessing.
alyssa: ok i'll create a short RFC with the sampling plan + metric names and flag gating. will ping infra for a short rollout to dev first. thanks all :thumbsup:
jorge: lgtm, add a short sanity-check dashboard so we can eyeball early spikes.
meera: can we also add a tiny retention for audit markers (7 days) to keep costs minimal?
sam: yes 7d sounds fine, backfill requires archive snapshot if needed beyond that.
alyssa: great. next actions: alyssa -> RFC and rollout plan, jorge -> ingress marker PR, meera -> reconciler correlation, sam -> runbook edits. I'll update thread when RFC is up.
